title: House Robber V
summary: Plan a robbery of houses along a street where each house has a money amount and a color code.
statement: Plan a robbery of houses along a street where each house has a money amount and a color code. Given arrays nums and colors, avoid robbing two adjacent houses with the same color code. Determine the maximum money that can be robbed.
constraints: nums and colors have the same positive length, up to 100,000.
You may rob adjacent houses unless those two houses have the same color; maximize the total.
hints: Only adjacent selected houses of the same color are forbidden.
Track the best total ending with the previous house skipped or taken.
For a matching-color edge, taking i must extend skip; otherwise it may extend the overall best.
The two states represent every valid choice for the processed prefix, and each transition enforces exactly the new edge constraint.
editorial: The two states represent every valid choice for the processed prefix, and each transition enforces exactly the new edge constraint.

tests.explanation: Rob houses worth four and five; each conflicts only with its same-colored neighbor, totaling nine.
Different colors do not conflict, so both houses yield five.
